title: Multistate income-tax apportionment
prompt:
Calculate the blended state income-tax rate and liability across the operating footprint.

Begin with the FY26 tax-provision and EBITDA-definition thread in `Requests/`, including the close-review follow-up. Use the current controller-tied workpapers and operating extracts, keeping earlier versions only for comparison. Resolve conflicts using dates, approvals, document status, and management correspondence. Keep the tax calculations tied to the controlling tax workpapers, policy, and jurisdiction detail.

Apply each state's documented sales, payroll, and property factors and weighting method. Exclude throwback sales only where the memo permits, apply nexus thresholds and state NOLs, and reconcile the apportioned income to the company total. Report each jurisdiction's apportioned taxable income before NOL and net state tax after NOL, together with the blended rate, gross liability, NOL benefit, net state tax, and highest-tax jurisdiction.

Do not modify files or post transactions. Return only one JSON object with exactly these keys: `oregon_state_taxable_income`, `washington_state_taxable_income`, `california_state_taxable_income`, `idaho_state_taxable_income`, `oregon_net_state_tax`, `washington_net_state_tax`, `california_net_state_tax`, `idaho_net_state_tax`, `blended_state_tax_rate`, `gross_state_tax`, `state_nol_benefit`, `net_state_tax`, `highest_tax_jurisdiction`. Use dollars to two decimals and ratios and percentages as decimal ratios to at least four decimals.
